h2: Plumber Canggu – Villa Water Fixes from Taps to Pumps
intro: When a tap drips at 2 a.m. or the cistron won't stop running, you need a Plumber Canggu who actually shows up with the right parts and fixes it on the spot. I work solo across Berawa, Batu Bolong and Echo Beach — no call centre, no subcontractors. Send me a photo on WhatsApp and I'll tell you what's wrong before I even arrive.

sections.h3: Why Canggu Villas Need More Plumbing Attention
sections.text: Canggu went from paddies to villa clusters in under a decade, and the plumbing infrastructure didn't always keep pace. The old rice-field soil holds water close to the surface, so septic tanks around Berawa fill faster than owners expect, and after a hard downpour the drains back up into garden beds. Add rapid construction with shortcuts on fittings and slope, and hidden leaks tend to announce themselves within the first two or three years. That's exactly where I step in — find the root cause rather than patch the symptom.

sections.h3: The Jobs I See Most Around Echo Beach
sections.text: Most call-outs follow a familiar pattern: a mixer that won't shut off, a cistern gurgling through the night, or pressure dropping the moment someone runs the shower upstairs. I replace worn cartridges, traps and hoses, re-slope flat drain lines, install new basins and toilets, and hook up washing machines or dishwashers without chasing walls. If it involves water going somewhere it shouldn't, or not reaching where it should, send me a short clip and I'll sort it out personally.

sections.h3: Getting a Quote – Just Send Photos on WhatsApp
sections.text: No phone calls, no booking forms. Open WhatsApp, snap a photo or brief video of the leak, the fitting, or the pump room, and message me what you're seeing. I look at it, tell you whether it's a quick fix or needs a proper visit, and give you a price based on the job itself — parts included. You approve, I come with everything needed. Simple as that, and you never deal with a dispatcher who doesn't know your villa layout.

sections.h3: Preventing the Next Call-Out Before Rainy Season Hits
sections.text: Before the October–March rains peak, walk your pool overflow channel, check that the submersible pump still kicks in, and make sure the septic inspection lid isn't cracked. In Batu Bolong especially, leaves from nearby fields clog surface drains within days, so clearing them monthly saves a flooded garden later. A five-minute flush of every outdoor tap also dislodges sediment before it settles into your pipes. Small habits now mean fewer 6 a.m. emergencies when the sky opens up.

faq.q: Do you cover all neighbourhoods in Canggu?
faq.a: Yes — Berawa, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Pererenan, Babakan and Padonan are all within my daily route. If your villa sits just outside those boundaries, send me the address on WhatsApp and I'll confirm.

faq.q: How is pricing decided for a plumbing repair?
faq.a: It depends entirely on the job — a cartridge swap costs less than re-routing a drain line. Send photos or a short video on WhatsApp and I'll quote you before any work starts.

faq.q: Can you handle both the house plumbing and the pool system?
faq.a: Absolutely. Pool pumps, overflow channels, backwash lines and the connections between the two are part of what I service, alongside taps, toilets and pressure issues inside the villa.
